items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And Leonard said, "Well, what could I call that. Bebop, okay."

ctx.x: of calling it "Bebop," because he would drop those bombs, and, you know, BRRP-BOP... And Leonard said, "Well, what could I call that. Bebop, okay." So he started to use the term "bebop." But Klook had been playing that for years.

But again, it's like you can play a phrase, and it might have the very same notes, you know melodically, and then by putting it in a different rhythmic pattern or putting it against at a different place in the structure tune...
